definitions.explanation: A noun naming a period or a rough point in time, always after a modifier: {子供|こども}のころ (when I was a child), {若|わか}いころ (in one's youth), あのころ (in those days), {桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}くころ (around the time the cherry blossoms bloom). Usually written in kana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often played in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{起|お}きていた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I stayed up late every night.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Back then, there were no mobile phones yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ころ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I played with friends every day. Looking back now, those were the most fun times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧ころ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧にぎわう。
examples.english: Around the time the cherry blossoms bloom, this town fills with tourists.

notes:
{頃|ころ} as a noun always follows something that defines the time: a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ), a verb or adjective (⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧ころ, ⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧ころ), or ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧, ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧. It is usually written in kana. Directly after a clock time or a question word it is the suffix ごろ instead (⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧ごろ, いつごろ; see 〜ころ and ⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ: when I was a child
- ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧ころ: when I was young
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ころ: in those days, back then
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ころ: at that time
- 〜たころ: around the time when ... (had happened)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時|とき}: time, when — a definite occasion; ころ is vaguer and often covers a stretch of time
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: era, age — a longer period of history or of one's life
- ⟦{頃合|ころあ}い→頃合い：14688_koroai⟧: the right moment, a suitable time
